2fuji200p02.jpg.title: Garden Court
2fuji200p02.jpg.description: I honestly didn't expect to see something like this in here. Somebody must have put a lot of time into it.
2fuji200p02.jpg.alt: An indoor garden with fountains and flower displays inside American Dream mall.

2fuji200p05.jpg.title: One World
2fuji200p05.jpg.description: The clouds reflected perfectly off the glass. Sometimes you just need to look up.
2fuji200p05.jpg.alt: One World Trade Center photographed from directly below against a blue sky.

2fuji200p06.jpg.title: Lower Manhattan
2fuji200p06.jpg.description: It's hard to walk around downtown without looking up every few seconds.
2fuji200p06.jpg.alt: One World Trade Center rises above surrounding buildings in Lower Manhattan.

2fuji200p08.jpg.title: Away From Brooklyn
2fuji200p08.jpg.description: This bridge has probably been photographed millions of times, but I still ended up with something unique.
2fuji200p08.jpg.alt: The Brooklyn Bridge viewed from the roadway approach with Lower Manhattan in the background.

2fuji200p09.jpg.title: Approaching Manhattan
2fuji200p09.jpg.description: I was always mesmerized by the Manhattan skyline. I photographed it almost every time I saw it.
2fuji200p09.jpg.alt: The Manhattan skyline viewed from a highway with One World Trade Center visible in the distance.

2fuji200p12.jpg.title: The City That Never Sleeps
2fuji200p12.jpg.description: I remember it being very late and it was still so bright. There were people everywhere.
2fuji200p12.jpg.alt: Times Square at night with illuminated billboards and traffic.

2fuji200p14.jpg.title: Evening Skyline
2fuji200p14.jpg.description: The sun was dropping behind us by the time we crossed the river.
2fuji200p14.jpg.alt: The Manhattan skyline at sunset viewed across the water with bridges in the foreground.

2fuji200p15.jpg.title: High Bridge
2fuji200p15.jpg.description: I almost missed this one while we were driving. I'm very glad I didn't.
2fuji200p15.jpg.alt: The High Bridge spans the Harlem River with the Manhattan skyline visible beyond.

2fuji200p16.jpg.title: Steel Frame
2fuji200p16.jpg.description: Something you may notice is that a lot of my photos have motion blur. Is it technically correct? No. But does it convey something better than a perfectly sharp image can? Occasionally.
2fuji200p16.jpg.alt: The Manhattan skyline seen through the steel beams of a bridge while in motion.

2fuji200p18.jpg.title: City Upon a Hill
2fuji200p18.jpg.description: The skyline keeps finding ways to appear, even when you think you've left it behind.
2fuji200p18.jpg.alt: The Manhattan skyline viewed across marshland from New Jersey.

2fuji200p20.jpg.title: Skyline of New York City in the Evening
2fuji200p20.jpg.description: This was one of the first times I came into New York. I just can't get enough of the skyline.
2fuji200p20.jpg.alt: A distant view of the Manhattan skyline from a highway.

2fuji200p21.jpg.title: Final Approach
2fuji200p21.jpg.description: I looked up at exactly the right time.
2fuji200p21.jpg.alt: An airliner descends toward Newark Liberty International Airport above utility poles and power lines.

2fuji200p26.jpg.title: American Dream
2fuji200p26.jpg.description: This was shortly before we arrived quite late in the afternoon. I was surprised that we had left so late, it was only a few hours until they closed.
2fuji200p26.jpg.alt: The exterior of American Dream mall seen from a moving vehicle.

3fuji200p28.jpg.title: Refinery
3fuji200p28.jpg.description: The skyline wasn't the last thing we saw before leaving New Jersey.
3fuji200p28.jpg.alt: An oil refinery illuminated against the evening sky beside a highway in New Jersey.
